text.tspan: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, click a
feature for its details. Parts are coloured;
cut and intersect tool volumes render
translucent so you can see what they removed.
Describe a change in plain English and an LLM
proposes a rewrite of the design recipe — not
a guess at the mesh, the actual parametric
A proposal renders here for you to read before
anything happens: apply in place to edit this
design with no new version, or save as a new
version and keep the original untouched.
